1 The page's description. Advanced is reached from the Notifications page; it keeps every setting the old page had.
2 Grouped by the part of the event the kind comes from; each group's kinds in a card with how many went out.
3 Channels as switches in words (a phone notification, a Discord message), each with a tooltip saying what it means; a lead time as a stepper with quick picks.
4 Your own kinds: a narrower copy of a kind, e.g. only Schedule items of the kind Cosplay. Choices, not typed fields.
5 'Only when': a field, a test and a value, each a list to pick from; the value list comes from the event's own data (here the run of show's item kinds).
